mk.analytisch.text: Weighs things up coolly and reads the game like a chess player.
mk.anpassungsfaehig.text: Settles quickly into new roles, systems and surroundings.
mk.arbeitstier.text: Runs and works for two and never eases off in training.
mk.bescheiden.text: Stays out of the spotlight and lets actions speak.
mk.direkt.text: Says openly what he thinks, even when it is uncomfortable.
mk.diszipliniert.text: Sticks to plans, rules and diet without complaint.
mk.ehrgeizig.text: Always wants more and sets high personal goals.
mk.emotional.text: Shows joy and anger openly, on the pitch and in the dressing room.
mk.erfahrener_mentor.text: Happily passes his experience on to the younger players.
mk.extrovertiert.text: Seeks contact, talks a lot and is in the middle of everything.
mk.exzentrisch.text: Goes his own way and surprises with unconventional appearances.
mk.fan_liebling.text: The terraces love him, and he gives it back.
mk.fruehreif.text: Plays more maturely than his age suggests.
mk.fuehrungsspieler.text: Leads from the front, organises his team-mates and takes responsibility.
mk.geduldig.text: Bides his time and is not easily rattled.
mk.gelassen.text: Stays loose even in heated moments.
mk.grosse_spiele.text: Gets better, not nervous, in the big matches.
mk.hitzkopf.text: Quickly loses his temper when things go wrong.
mk.introvertiert.text: Keeps to himself, thinks a lot and needs quiet.
mk.kreativer_freigeist.text: Follows his instincts and tries what nobody expects.
mk.kaempfer.text: Never gives up and throws himself into every challenge.
mk.launisch.text: His mood swings, and his form with it.
mk.lautsprecher.text: Has an opinion on everything and voices it loudly.
mk.loyal.text: Stays true to his club, even when others tempt him.
mk.medienprofi.text: Knows exactly what to say in front of a microphone or camera.
mk.medienscheu.text: Avoids interviews and cameras wherever possible.
mk.nervenstark.text: Delivers even when everything is at stake.
mk.perfektionist.text: Is never satisfied with good and polishes every detail.
mk.provokateur.text: Winds up opponents and referees to the limit.
mk.risikofreudig.text: Dares the unexpected and accepts mistakes.
mk.selbstbewusst.text: Believes in himself and carries himself that way.
mk.sensibel.text: Takes criticism and moods in especially strongly.
mk.showman.text: Loves the big stage and the crowd.
mk.siegermentalitaet.text: Hates losing and wants to win every match.
mk.social_media_star.text: Has millions of followers and looks after his online presence.
mk.sozial_engagiert.text: Works for people and projects away from the pitch.
mk.spassvogel.text: Keeps the dressing room cheerful with light-hearted banter.
mk.vorbild_profi.text: Shows how a professional works and behaves.
mk.wechselfreudig.text: Often has his next move in mind before his contract ends.
